t: A 184 page book of screen-free computational thinking activities for ages 3 to 8.
steps: Find Kindercoding Unplugged from Redleaf Press or another seller.
Check the price with your seller.
Read the activity pages and pick one.
Gather low-cost materials such as grid paper, figurines, beads, and dice.
Set up the coding grid with a figurine and plastic fruit.
Use the observation notes to plan the next step.
